# @nymrel/machine-trust

> Dual-Audience Machine Trust & AI Search Discoverability Engine for Modern Web Applications. Generates, validates, and audits Schema.org JSON-LD entity graphs, standard /llms.txt machine indexes, AI search crawler policies, and DOM parity.

## Core Modules

- [JSON-LD Generator](https://github.com/nymrel/machine-trust/blob/main/src/generators/jsonLd.ts): Generates verifiable Schema.org graphs with Nymrel -> JalenBuilds LLC entity hierarchy.
- [LLMs.txt Generator](https://github.com/nymrel/machine-trust/blob/main/src/generators/llmsTxt.ts): Builds token-budgeted /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt machine indexes.
- [Robots.txt Engine](https://github.com/nymrel/machine-trust/blob/main/src/generators/robotsTxt.ts): Establishes explicit discovery rules for OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, and ClaudeBot.
- [Answer-First Generator](https://github.com/nymrel/machine-trust/blob/main/src/generators/answerFirst.ts): Generates 40-60 word executive summaries for sub-second AI extraction.
- [DOM Consistency Validator](https://github.com/nymrel/machine-trust/blob/main/src/validators/domConsistency.ts): Verifies structured data parity with visible DOM copy to prevent penalties.
- [Crawler Access Validator](https://github.com/nymrel/machine-trust/blob/main/src/validators/crawlerAccess.ts): Audits robots.txt rules for AI search crawler eligibility.
- [Audit Scorecard Reporter](https://github.com/nymrel/machine-trust/blob/main/src/reporters/scorecard.ts): Produces 100-point composite Machine Trust Scorecards.

## Optional & Umbrella Context

- [Nymrel Umbrella](https://nymrel.com): Autonomous software systems and digital services portfolio.
- [JalenBuilds LLC](https://jalenbuilds.com): Parent venture studio holding company.
